🚀Heavy-Duty Metal Storage Rack | 100KG/Layer | Screw-Free Fast Assembly | SG Local Stock

Are you tired of messy rooms, weak shelves, shaking racks, or boards that bend after a few months?

This upgraded heavy-duty metal rack is designed for Singapore homes—stronger, thicker, and easier to install, giving you rock-solid storage instantly.

📌📌📌The size of the packaging box is not related to the actual size of the shelf (please consult customer service if you have any questions)📌📌📌

🔥 Why This Rack Is the Best Choice for Singapore Homes

1️⃣ Upgraded Strength — TRUE 100KG/Layer Load-Bearing

Most racks on the market claim “heavy-duty” but bend easily.

This one uses thickened double-sided steel columns + reinforced crossbeams under every panel.

Even when fully loaded with water bottles, appliances, tools, or storage boxes, it stays stable with no shaking.

2️⃣ Screw-Free Fast Installation — Assemble in Minutes

No tools, no screws, no frustration.

Click-in buckle structure makes installation simple—like building blocks.

Perfect for anyone who wants quick setup without drilling or fixing parts.

3️⃣ Adjustable Layers — Fits Any Singapore Home Space

Each layer can be repositioned freely to fit tall items, small boxes, cleaning supplies, fans, printers, luggage, and more.

One rack works for bedrooms, storerooms, kitchens, offices, even HDB service yards.

🧾 Shelf Type Breakdown & Feature Explanation

📌📌“Standard”

🪵 Shelf Board: No extra support beam underneath

🧩 Upright Posts: Split design for 150cm/180cm height – requires assembly

📌📌“Thick”

🪵 Shelf Board: Includes an extra support beam for enhanced weight capacity

🧩 Upright Posts: Still split-type for 150cm/180cm height – assembly required

📌📌“1Whole”

🪵 Shelf Board: Same as "Thick" – with an extra support beam

🏗️ Upright Posts: One-piece full-length 180cm posts – no joint assembly needed

🔧 Benefit: Stronger and more stable with easier setup

📌📌“Peg-B----pegboard”

🪵 Shelf Board: Same as “1Whole” – includes extra support beam

🏗️ Upright Posts: One-piece full-length 180cm posts

🧲 Additional Feature: Comes with a pegboard back panel for hanging tools or accessories

Easy Assembly



The storage box comes with clear instructions, making assembly a breeze, so you can start organizing your space right away.






Convenient Storage



This storage cabinet with doors provides convenient storage for various items, from snacks to children's toys, keeping your space clutter-free.






Versatile Use



Ideal for families with children, this storage cabinet can be used in bedrooms, playrooms, or kitchens, offering versatile storage solutions.






Compact Size



With its compact size, this storage cabinet doesn't take up much space, allowing you to maximize your storage capacity without sacrificing floor space.






Durable Plastic Material



Made from durable plastic, this storage box is designed to withstand daily use, ensuring long-lasting performance and reliability.
